::: {.obsidian-shift-handover}
:::

State the shift summary in one paragraph. Note what happened, what
changed, and anything the next shift must know.

# Status

State the status of each system or task. Use a table with system,
status, and notes columns.

# Open items

List the items that carry over to the next shift. For each, name
the owner and the expected resolution.

# Safety notes

Record any safety-relevant events and the actions taken.
